purpose: Answer the progressive-darkening concern with a stricter fixed-camera luminance gate while testing irregular, surface-conforming runtime hairline cards and clustered end lengths.

iterationResults.finding: A lighter owned deep-brown atlas and clustered long-card lengths stopped the darkening trend, but 154 wide hairline cards produced coarse saw-tooth clumps.

220 narrower hairline cards reduced root clearance repairs from 218 to 16 vertices and passed all collision/motion frames. The finer strip remains too combed and isolated front lines still cross the forehead.

contrast.gate: whole frame must not be darker than r371

failures: The hairline remains a visible combed strip instead of clustered human growth.
Several isolated straight cards cross the right forehead.
The crown remains broad and procedural.
Side and rear silhouettes remain too curtain-like.
Browser alpha sorting, memory and FPS are not yet audited.

decision: Retain r383 as the offline authoring source. Use r392 only as the current runtime technical prototype and brightness reference; keep website v83 unchanged.
nextRequiredWork: Rebuild the hairline from anatomical growth zones with tapered clumps, remove forehead-crossing cards, break the long-card curtain silhouette, then run browser performance and alpha-sorting gates.
